title: Implementation and evaluation of group psychotherapeutic interventions in patients with chronic pain - a controlled clinical trial
summary: The study follows the principles of implementation research and looks at how new treatments can best be introduced and used in clinical practice to maximize patient benefit.
conditions: Chronic pain disorder with somatic and psychological factors

interventions.name: The participants receive manualized group psychotherapy consisting of eight sessions. In addition, there is a ninth session for the patient's relatives.

The participants receive manualized group psychotherapy consisting of eight sessions. In addition, there is a ninth session for the patient's relatives.  In comparison to arm 1, four additional body therapy sessions with elements of Argentinean tango take place.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Written consent to participate in the study
- Fluency in German
Exclusion criteria:
- Severe psychiatric illnesses according to ICD-10 (psychoses, addictions, bipolar disorders or severe cases of chronic pain)
- Suicidal thoughts
- Lack of capacity to consent
